fields.label: Layout
fields.name: layout
fields.instructions: "Split" puts the photo collage alongside the copy. "Centred" drops the collage and centres the text.

fields.label: Breadcrumb
fields.name: breadcrumb
fields.instructions: The name of this page. "Home" is added in front automatically. Leave empty to hide the breadcrumb.

fields.label: Brand mark
fields.name: logo
fields.instructions: Optional. Shown above the heading, in place of the eyebrow.

fields.label: Eyebrow
fields.name: eyebrow
fields.instructions: Small uppercase line. Ignored when a brand mark is set.

fields.label: Highlighted words
fields.name: heading_highlight
fields.instructions: Words from the heading to colour in the accent. Must match exactly.

fields.label: Main button link
fields.name: cta_url
fields.instructions: A full URL, or an anchor on this page such as #enquire.

fields.label: Reassurance points
fields.name: points
fields.instructions: The short lines with coloured dots under the buttons. Three works best.

fields.label: Small photograph
fields.name: photo_inset
fields.instructions: Overlaps the bottom-left corner of the large one.

fields.label: Floating card heading
fields.name: card_heading
fields.instructions: The small white card over the photographs. Leave empty to hide it.
